（一）未经考前允许，考试开始后在课桌、座位、身体等处有书籍、笔记、纸条或者文字等与考试内容相关资料，或者携带存储有与考试内容相关资料的电子设备的；

（四）考试过程中抄袭与考试内容相关资料的；

evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Management Implementation Rules (2025-12-04)

claims.text: General exam rules assign probation or above for the Article 25 categories involving obtaining or transmitting exam materials/answers or collaborative copying. Article 26 assigns expulsion for organizing cheating by three or more, impersonation, repeat cheating or other egregious cheating. Apply the actual facts and procedure, not a universal AI penalty.

evidence.quote:
第二十五条　有下列考试作弊情形之一的，给予留校察看以上处分：

（三）再次考试作弊的；
（四）其他情节恶劣的作弊情形。
evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Management Implementation Rules (2025-12-04)

These disciplinary regulations cover ordinary undergraduate and graduate degree students, with the specified analogous application for non-degree professional graduate students.

evidence.quote:

evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Management Regulations (2025-12-04)

claims.text: In student discipline, the student’s unit conducts preliminary verification and decides within five working days whether to register handling or discipline, files with the competent university authority and reports back. This is separate from the 15-working-day research-investigation acceptance stage.

evidence.quote: 第五条　涉嫌违纪学生所在院系负责对学生涉嫌违纪的行为进行初步核实，在五个工作日内作出是否予以立项处理或者处分的决定，并报学校主管机构备案，同时反馈给报告人或举报人。

claims.text: Before student discipline, the proposed-sanction notice must specify the sanction type, basis, term, facts and evidence, and the rights to statement and defense. Proposed expulsion also carries a hearing-request right; students may contest the notice.

evidence.quote:
第十五条　立项后，涉嫌违纪学生所在院系或者相应的主管机构负责调查取证，调查取证完成后由所在院系决策会议提出纪律处分建议，主管机构依据院系纪律处分建议及违纪事实形成拟处分意见，以学校拟处分告知书形式送达学生本人。
拟处分告知书应当告知拟给予的处分种类、依据、期限以及相关事实、证据，并告知学生享有陈述和申辩的权利，拟给予开除学籍处分的还应当告知学生享有申请召开听证会的权利。
第十六条　学生对拟处分告知书的相关内容有异议的，可以提出陈述、申辩，对拟给予开除学籍处分有异议的还可以申请召开听证会。
evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Management Regulations (2025-12-04)

claims.text: After delivery of a proposed student-sanction notice, the student, guardian or authorized representative has five working days to request written or oral statement/defense; oral requests must be arranged within five working days. Proposed expulsion carries a written hearing-request deadline of ten days after receipt, subject to the stated waiver conditions.

evidence.quote:
第十七条　学生（监护人或者委托代理人）对拟处分告知书相关内容有异议的，在拟处分告知书送达之日起五个工作日内，可以向学校主管机构提出书面或口头陈述、申辩请求。
学生（监护人或者委托代理人）请求进行口头陈述、申辩的，学校主管机构应当于请求提出之日起五个工作日内予以安排，并作好笔录。
第十八条　拟被给予开除学籍处分的学生有申请召开听证会的权利。
（一）拟被处分学生应当在收到拟处分告知书后的十日内向主管机构书面提出听证申请。逾期未提出听证申请，或者无正当理由未出席听证会的，视为放弃听证权利。
（二）拟被处分学生放弃听证权利的，不得再次提出听证申请。
evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Work Implementation Measures (2025-12-04)

claims.text: Demerit and lesser student sanctions are decided after leadership-office discussion; probation and expulsion require university affairs meeting determination after leadership-office discussion. Expulsion also requires prior legality review.

（二）给予留校察看或者开除学籍处分，经校领导办公会讨论后，由校务会议研究决定。给予开除学籍处分的，还应当事先进行合法性审查。

evidence.title: Student Disciplinary Management Regulations (2025-12-04)

claims.text: The student appeal measures apply to the listed university decisions on admission/student status, withdrawal, non-issuance of academic/degree certificates, and disciplinary sanctions. They do not establish a generic appeal deadline for an ordinary mark dispute.

evidence.quote:
第三条 本办法所指的申诉，是指学生因不服学校作出的下列处理或处分决定所提起的校内申诉：

evidence.title: Student Appeal Handling Measures

claims.text: A student contesting a decision listed in Article 3 may submit a written internal appeal within ten days of delivery of the effective decision document. evidence.quote:
第十六条 学生对本办法第三条所规定的学校处理或者处分决定有异议的，在学校处理或者处分决定的生效文书送达之日起十日内，可以向学生申诉处理委员会提出书面申诉。
学生因正当理由未能在规定期限内提出申诉的，可以于正当理由结束之日起十日内，向学生申诉处理委员会提出书面申诉。
evidence.title: Student Appeal Handling Measures

claims.text: The appeal office notifies acceptance or reasoned refusal within three working days of submitted materials. Receipt of an appeal is calculated from confirmed acceptance. The original decision generally continues during appeal; the committee may recommend deferral where necessary.

evidence.quote:
第十九条 学生申诉处理委员会办公室应当在学生提交申诉申请书面材料之日起三个工作日内，书面告知其学生申诉处理委员会是否予以受理。不予受理的，还应当书面说明理由。
第二十条 学生申诉处理委员会接到书面申诉的日期，以确认受理该申诉申请之日起计算。
第二十一条 申诉期间原处理或处分决定原则上不停止执行。学生申诉处理委员会认为必要的，可以建议学校暂缓执行。
evidence.title: Student Appeal Handling Measures

claims.text: For an accepted internal student appeal, the committee normally makes a written review conclusion within fifteen days of receipt; complex cases may extend fifteen days with the chair’s approval. Receipt is defined by Article 20 as confirmed acceptance. This is not the filing deadline.

evidence.quote:
第二十四条 学生申诉处理委员会在接到学生书面申诉之日起十五日内，根据实际情况作出相应的书面复查结论：

（二）认为原处理或处分决定所依据的事实认定不清、发现新的重要证据、处理或处分依据错误或在程序上有错误，可能对原处理或处分决定有实质性影响，建议原处理或处分机构重新研究决定。
因情况复杂不能在规定限期内作出结论的，经学生申诉处理委员会主任批准，限期可延长十五日。
evidence.title: Student Appeal Handling Measures

claims.text: For periods under the student appeal measures, the starting day is not counted and time in transit is excluded. Do not convert the stated day periods into working days.

evidence.quote: 第三十条 本办法中的有关期间，开始当日不计算在期间内，期间不包括在途时间。
